[[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Average (3, Hard Mode) |hidden = No |immunity = None }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Zombegg''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Eggy Island]] as part of [[Spring 2020 Event]]. Being the first enemy that appeared, it had quite low health and walked slowly in easy mode. It had average speed in hard mode and had much more health, making it harder to kill. ==Appearance== The '''Zombegg''' had cyan blue skin, and its torso and legs were brown. It had a yellow egg with pink zig-zag going around it for its head. Its head would sway from side to side slightly as it walked. Its head was slightly tilted downwards. ==Strategy== *In easy mode, pretty much anything can effectively take the '''Zombegg''' out. **If you are going to save up for the [[Minigunner]], then placing down a couple of [[Sniper]]s or [[Soldier]]s can work while you save up for it. *In hard mode, the [[Archer|Holiday Archer]] upgraded to at least Level 3 can work quite well against hordes of '''Zombeggs'''. *You can use the [[Pyromancer]], [[Freezer]] or [[Electroshocker]] to slow the '''Zombegg''' down and give your towers more time to kill it. You are automatically given the [[Pyromancer]] in easy mode. **The [[Pyromancer]] can also be very useful at dealing damage to '''Zombegg''' as they spawn in hordes if placed near the entrance. *In hard mode, you can use the [[Rocketeer]] or [[Demoman]] to defeat the '''Zombegg''' as they normally spawn in hordes. ==Trivia== *'''Zombegg''' was a portmanteau of the words "zombie" and "egg". ==Update History== *'''6 April 2020''' - [[Release v1.9|Release v1.9.0]] **'''Zombegg''' added. *'''26 May 2020''' - [[Release v1.11|Release v1.11.0]] **'''Zombegg''' removed. {{EggyIsland|Start
